title: DIR Target-Contract Correction and Dataset Requalification
previous_C3X_decision_preserved: yes -- historical qualification based on the then-understood target contract; C3X artifacts are NOT edited or deleted
reason: fixation exclusion and matched-perception identity mapping not yet certified
findings_to_resolve: C3X used all 26 bdpy Label values as imagery contents; DIR imagery = 25 targets + 1 fixation block per run (20 runs x 26 blocks = 520 samples = 500 target + 20 fixation). Fixation must be excluded.

DIR imagery targets = 10 natural images + 15 artificial images; matched perception requires BOTH perceptionNaturalImageTest AND perceptionArtificialImage. C3X downloaded only perceptionNaturalImageTest.
Numeric local Label overlap was treated as shared stimulus identity without an authoritative cross-condition mapping.
Combined-family reliability risks a natural-vs-artificial separation confound; within-family stimulus-specific reliability must be reported (R_I_natural, R_I_artificial).
'category/image identity' wording is ambiguous; DIR uses specific memorized IMAGE exemplars (not GOD object categories) -- terminology to be frozen.
note: This is a PROVENANCE CORRECTION, not an outcome-driven re-analysis. C3X is NOT declared invalid; it is superseded by the corrected C3XA replay.
